tagline: A small onchain Model to Confirm onchain Identity Rollup for fun
description: An Onchain Model to Confirm Identity Rollup (IRU) refers to a blockchain-based mechanism for verifying and confirming the authenticity of identity-related data within an identity rollup system. Identity rollup is a concept within the blockchain and cryptocurrency space that involves aggregating multiple identity-related transactions or data into a single, efficient, and secure batch transaction on the blockchain. This helps reduce congestion and transaction fees on the blockchain while maintaining the integrity and privacy of user identities.
